messages:
samir: Quick sync — I'm prototyping a "preview effective config" flow for canary cohorts in Console. Want to show the resolved runtime values (defaults + overrides + cohort rules) before you hit publish. Any immediate blockers?
elaine: :eyes: sounds great. Two requirements: 1) only visible to approvers (IAM), 2) include a snapshot id for audit so results are reproducible.
kevin: Is this different from our dry-run route tests? We do route dry-run but never materialize the fully resolved config. Concern: computing full resolution for large cohort sets could be heavy.
maria: We could offer sampling. API could accept sample=N and a seed so preview is deterministic but cheap. That should cover most UX cases.
samir: Agree. Draft API shape: GET /configs/:id/preview?cohort=<name>&sample=100&seed=42  — returns resolved values + snapshot_id + delta vs prod. Example: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/configs/abc123/preview?cohort=beta-group&sample=100&seed=42"
```
Response (proto):
```json
{
  "snapshot_id": "snap_2024-11-05_001",
  "cohort_sample_size": 100,
  "effective": {"route":"priority","quota":"50r/s","cache_ttl":"30s"},
  "delta": {"quota":"+10r/s","estimated_cost_min_per_hour":"$0.12"}
}
```
ops-bot: deploy-bot: preview-service v2 deployed to staging (tag: preview/v2) :rocket:
elaine: Telemetry is key: when preview is invoked, emit `config.preview` with tags {config_id, user_id, cohort, sample, seed, snapshot_id}. But we need to rate-limit / sample telemetry so we don't leak cohort membership or PII.
kevin: Also: caching/ETag semantics. If preview reads live defaults, results will drift. We should snapshot the set of defaults at preview-time and return `snapshot_id` so audits match what was shown. That snapshot can be garbage-collected after X days.
maria: UX idea: show a small simulated traffic slider: "Simulate 5k reqs over 5m" and show projected latency/cost & quota hits. Could wire to the same preview engine.
samir: Implementation plan I'm thinking: 1) preview API + input validation, 2) preview worker that resolves cohort sample + snapshots defaults, 3) store snapshot_id + small blob in objectstore, 4) UI diff (delta vs prod) with inline cost estimate, 5) record preview in rollout history if user chooses.
julia: Quick question on approvals: do we auto-record previews in the rollout timeline? I vote yes — saves back-and-forth and gives context to approvers.
kevin: A few infra notes: - ensure preview worker honors per-customer quotas to avoid noisy neighbors - mask secrets/KMS ARNs in the response (redact) - preview endpoints should be RBACed and logged.
samir: Good call. Also thinking about a `dry_run=true` flag on the existing apply API for small targeted tests, but keep preview read-only. Separate responsibilities.
elaine: One more: add an action button in Console — "Create snapshot + open approval" which does the preview + creates a snapshot + opens PR-like approval flow.
maria: For telemetry gating: sample previews at 1% by default in prod for metrics pipeline, but surface opt-out for security-sensitive teams.
samir: I'll spin up a short RFC + API spec and drop it here. Will include telemetry schema and retention defaults. Link incoming: <https://go/infra/config-preview-rfc/123>
kevin: I'll take the caching/worker piece. Assign to me and I'll prototype a sample API clamped to 100 sample size.
ops-bot: issue created: ENG-4321 "config preview API + snapshots" assigned -> kevin
samir: Thanks — will add acceptance criteria: reproducible snapshot, RBAC, delta UI, telemetry event. Planning to land initial endpoint in staging next week and test with the beta cohort.
elaine: :thumbsup: please add a small privacy checklist in the RFC (cohort leakage, PII, audit retention).
samir: Yep — adding that now. Will ping when PR is ready for review.
